subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: After the sandbox correctness defects are repaired, should `append` become a durable model-facing capability of the core `write` tool?
rationale: This adds a new core tool parameter that models and integrations may learn and depend on, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve consistent append
options.body: Adopt the capability only after all backends provide a consistent guarded append contract and the contributor supplies real-path proof.

options.title: Keep overwrite-only core
options.body: Decline the new core parameter and pursue a narrower owner-specific workflow or tool surface instead.

recommendation.title: Approve consistent append
recommendation.body: Adopt the capability only after all backends provide a consistent guarded append contract and the contributor supplies real-path proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest historical footprint across the core write-tool surface and are the best available owner for the lasting product-contract choice.
